name: Trapped-key transfer permissive
summary: Represents the required transfer of a key between equipment to enforce an operating dependency.
description: Represents the required transfer of a key between equipment to enforce an operating dependency. An interlocking function permits or blocks an operation according to the positions and conditions of related equipment. Electrical, mechanical and trapped-key interlocks implement different parts of a coordinated operating philosophy.

In a switchgear feeder panel, a control diagram can prevent an incompatible combination of breaker, disconnector and earthing-switch positions. The physical equipment documents determine which restrictions are mechanically enforced. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Key availability” at the input and “Dependent operation permission” at the output. Key sequence and electrical state are different evidence.
